summary: Tested Health Portal backend auth/translation APIs and frontend login/dashboard/i18n flows. After fixing a critical ObjectId serialization bug in /api/auth/register and /api/auth/google/session, all 20 backend tests pass. Frontend login, language switcher (English/Farsi with RTL dir='rtl'), and protected dashboard route all work correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Label shows raw i18n key 'userType:' instead of translated 'User Type:' under the welcome heading (the second Profile field 'User Type' renders correctly, but the inline label near welcome message is untranslated)

issues: Right half is occupied by a large abstract image while the left form is centered with lots of empty whitespace above; acceptable but could be tightened on smaller laptop screens

action_items: Fix i18n: the inline 'userType:' label on Dashboard is not running through the translation function (likely missing t() call or wrong key). Translated 'User Type' under Profile Information works fine — just the top inline label needs the same treatment in all 3 locales.
Consider adding a user_type selector / completion step after Google OAuth signup since it currently defaults to 'Patient' silently (server.py line 231).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by tester: /api/auth/register and /api/auth/google/session were returning the post-insert user_doc which Motor mutates to include MongoDB ObjectId('_id'), causing 500 errors during FastAPI response serialization. Added user_doc.pop('_id', None) before return in both endpoints.

get_current_user uses heuristic token.startswith('test_session_') or len(token) > 200 to distinguish Google session vs JWT — fragile. Prefer trying jwt.decode first and falling back to session lookup on JWTError, or use distinct cookie names.
JWT_SECRET has insecure default fallback string in code. Should fail fast if missing in production.
Google OAuth creates users with hardcoded user_type='Patient' without giving the user a chance to choose — UX gap.
No rate limiting on /auth/login or /auth/register — brute-force risk.

Cookie set with samesite='none', secure=True is correct for cross-site, but logout only clears cookie if token present in cookies; if user authed via Authorization header, server session document is never invalidated.
/api/translate has no input length validation — large texts could rack up LLM cost.
Passwords are stored alongside user document; consider a separate credentials collection or at minimum keep projection {'_id':0,'password':0} on read paths to avoid accidental leaks.

rca_of_the_issue: Register endpoint 500 root cause: db.users.insert_one(user_doc) mutates user_doc in-place by injecting MongoDB's _id (ObjectId). The same dict was then returned in the response. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize bson.ObjectId, raising ValueError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"). Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with a fresh email returns 500 (duplicate email path returns 400 before insert, so that worked). Mitigation applied: pop '_id' from user_doc before returning. Same pattern was present in /api/auth/google/session and also fixed.
